description: Source code for handling WRGG headers in MTD devices, including functions for fixing MD5 checksums and updating headers on flash memory.

methods.name: wrgg_fix_md5
methods.description: Recalculates and updates the MD5 checksum in the WRGG header if necessary.

methods.name: mtd_fixwrgg
methods.description: Fixes the WRGG header in an MTD device at a specified offset, updating the checksum and rewriting the block.
